definitions.gloss: lining cloth; backing fabric; lining material
definitions.explanation: Fabric used as the inner layer of a garment or textile product. Covers the inside of clothing to hide seams and provide comfort against the skin.

examples.japanese: {裏布|うらぬの}を{縫|ぬ}い{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To sew on the lining cloth.

examples.japanese: バッグの{裏布|うらぬの}に{花柄|はながら}の{生地|きじ}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose a floral fabric for the bag's lining cloth.

examples.japanese: {手作|てづく}りのポーチを{作|つく}るとき、{裏布|うらぬの}を{付|つ}けると{仕上|しあ}がりがきれいになるし、{中身|なかみ}も{取|と}り{出|だ}しやすくなる。
examples.english: When making a handmade pouch, adding a lining cloth gives it a cleaner finish and makes it easier to take things in and out.

notes:
A compound of {裏|うら} (back, reverse, inside) and {布|ぬの} (cloth, fabric). Used primarily in sewing and handicraft contexts. While {裏地|うらじ} is the more common term for lining in general clothing and fashion, {裏布|うらぬの} specifically emphasizes the physical piece of cloth used as lining material, and is especially common in sewing patterns and DIY craft instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏布|うらぬの}を{縫|ぬ}い{付|つ}ける: to sew on the lining
- {裏布|うらぬの}を{裁断|さいだん}する: to cut the lining fabric
- {裏布|うらぬの}{付|つ}き: with lining
- {裏布|うらぬの}なし: without lining; unlined

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏地|うらじ}: lining — the more common general term for garment lining
- {表地|おもてじ}: outer fabric — the visible exterior fabric, the counterpart to lining
- {接着芯|せっちゃくしん}: fusible interfacing — a stiff material ironed onto fabric for structure
